paite: Huan sinagog ah alut nawn a; huai ah khutzaw khat ana om hi.
heading: Mi Khutzaw Hihdamna / (Mat 12.1-8; Luk 6.1-5)

paite: Amah ahektheihna ding un Sabbath ni a ahihdam nop leh nop louh a-enkhia uhi.
Ama'n khutzaw kiang ah, "Dingkhia in," achi hi.
Huan akiang uah, "Sabbath ni in hihhoih hia siang, hihsiat? Hotdam hia siang, hihlup?" chi in adong hi. Himahleh adai dide uhi.
Huan alungtang uh tak ziak a lungkham mahmah leh heh kawm a amaute a-et velvel nung in, huai mi kiang ah, "Na khut zan in," achi a, huchi in azankhia a, akhut adamta hi.
Pharisaite apawtkhia ua, amah hihlup theihna ding lampi ngaihtuah in Herod pawl a mite toh akihoukhawm pah uhi.
Jesu anungzuite toh tuipi lam ah apaimang ua; Galili gam a kipan mipi tampitak in azui uhi.
heading: Hihdamna Dangte

paite: Athilhih thupidan azak un Judia gam a kipan, Jerusalem a kipan, Idumai gam a kipan, Jordan gal a kipan, Tura leh Sidon kho kim a kipan in mipi tampitak akiang ah ahong pai uhi.
Mipi ziak in amah a dia long neu mansa a om ding in anungzuite ahilh hi, huchi lou in zaw hon um lutlut kha ding uhi.
Mipi tampi ahihdam tak ziak in natna nei peuhmah in amah akhoihtheihna ding un aboh huthut uhi.
Dawi ninte'n leng amah amuh un ama ah bokkhup in, "Nang Pathian Tapa na hi," chi in akikou uhi.
Huan atanchin genthang lou ding in akiang uah achi bikbek hi.
Huan tang ah ahohtou a, ama'n angaihngaih akiang ah asam a; amau akiang ah ahohtou uhi.
heading: Sawltak Sawm-le-nih Telna / (Mat 10.1-4; Luk 6.12-16)

paite: Akiang a om ding leh thugen dia asawlkhiak ding in sawm-le-nihte asep hi.
Natnate hihdam ding leh dawite delhkhe ding in thuneihna apia hi.
Huai mite, Simon, Peter, achih pa;
Zebedai tapa, Jakob leh Jakob unau Johan, huai mite Boanerges achihte; huai omdan tuh vanpiging tapate chihna ahi.
Andru, Philip, Bartholomai, Matthai, Thomas, Alphai tapa Jakob, Thaddai, Kanaan mi Simon leh,
amansakpa, Judas Iskariot ahi uhi.
Huai zoh in, inn khat ah alut uhi. Huai ah mipi tampi ahong kikhawm nawn ua, huchi in an nangawn leng ane thei kei uhi.
heading: Jesu Leh Beelzibul / (Mat 12.22-32; Luk 11.14-23; 12.10)

paite: Huan alawmte'n azak un, "Lungsim buai ahita," chi in amah mat atum uhi.
Huan laigelhmi, Jerusalem a kipan a hong sukte'n, "Beelzibul zawl ahi, dawite kumpipa ziak in ahi, dawite adelhkhiak," achi uhi.
Jesu'n laigelhmite asam a, gentehna in akiang uah, "Setan in Setan mah bangchi in adelhkhe thei dia?
Gam leng amah akidouleh huai gam adingkhe thei kei ding hi.
Inkuan khat leng amah akidou uleh, huaite inkuan adingkhe thei kei ding uhi.
Setan leng amah kidou a, akilanleh adingkhe thei kei ding a, amangthang zaw ding hi.
Kuamah in mihatpa ahen masak phot keileh inn a lut in asum alaksak thei kei uh, huai nung in bel a-inn alok mai ding uhi.
"Chihtaktak in ka hon hilh ahi, mihing tate, akhelhna tengteng uah leh Pathian agensiatna bangpeuh uah leng agensiatnate uh ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
Kuapeuh Kha Siangthou hilhial gensia zaw chik mah chiang in ngaihdam ahi kei ding a, tangtawn khelhna ah siam louh in a-om zaw ding," achi hi.
Dawi nin pai ahi, achih ziak un huai agen ahi.
Huan anu leh a-unaute ahong ua, inpua ah adingh ua; amah sam ding in mi asawl uhi.
heading: Jesu Nu Leh Sanggamte / (Mat 12.46-50; Luk 8.19-21)

paite: Akim a mipi tu diamduamte'n akiang ah, "Ngai dih, inpua ah na nu leh na sanggampate'n ahon ngak uh," achi uhi.
Ama'n akiang uah, "Ka nu leh ka sanggampate kuate ahi ua?" chi in adong hi.
Akiang a tute a-en vialvial a, "En un, ka nu leh ka sanggampate;
kuapeuh Pathian deihlam hih photphot ka sanggampa, ka sanggamnu leh ka nu ahi uh," achi hi.
